summary.short: Draft CAC measures for designated large personal information handlers: designation criteria (including processing data of 10 million or more individuals), localisation and cross-border transfer duties, automated-decision and minors' safeguards, impact assessments, audits, reporting and an external-majority supervisory committee. Effective date blank; comments close 7 Sept 2026.
summary.long: The draft would let the CAC and other personal-information authorities designate large personal information handlers. Designation considers processing data of 10 million or more individuals, providing important network services or multi-business operations involving personal information, and impact on national security, the economy, social stability or public health and safety (Art. 2-3). Chapter 2 sets processing duties: transparent rules, separate consent for transfers, public disclosure, sensitive data and sharing, guardian consent for under-14s, domestic storage in designated data centres (Art. 13-14), an option to switch off personalised push, data portability within 30 working days, and cross-border transfers under security assessment, standard contract or certification (Art. 20). Chapter 3 requires a responsible officer, internal systems, annual social responsibility reports, pre-launch impact assessments for automated-decision and sensitive-data products, minors' compliance audits, and audits every two years. Chapter 4 requires a supervisory committee of at least seven members, two-thirds external, formed within six months of designation. Chapter 5 provides for filings, inspections, interviews, rectification and committee dissolution, and refers penalties to the PIPL and other laws. The effective date is blank (Art. 50).

evidence.provision: 工作规则制定指引 十五
evidence.quote: 主要股东，是指持有大型个人信息处理者百分之五以上股份
数据中心管理机构，是指负责大型个人信息处理者个人信息处理活动全生命周期安全管理工作的组织机构
业务部门，是指大型个人信息处理者内部负责产品、服务研发、运营等的相关部门
对大型个人信息处理者的认定，应当综合考虑下列条件

definitions.defined_in: 工作规则制定指引 十五

evidence.provision: 工作规则制定指引 十五
evidence.quote: 主要股东，是指持有大型个人信息处理者百分之五以上股份

obligations.summary: Designation as a large personal information handler is assessed on combined conditions: handling personal information of 10 million or more natural persons; providing important online services involving personal information handling, or multi-business operations involving such handling; and handling with important impact on national security, economic operation, social stability, public health and safety.

evidence.quote: 对大型个人信息处理者的认定，应当综合考虑下列条件

obligations.summary: Handlers meeting the 10 million threshold, or self-assessed as meeting the second or third condition, must declare large-handler designation through the provincial network department to the national network department, with required materials.
obligations.conditional_on: Handling personal information of 10 million or more natural persons, or self-assessment meeting Art. 2 para. 2 items 2 or 3

evidence.quote: 应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报大型个人信息处理者认定

obligations.summary: Provincial network departments must complete completeness checks within 15 working days of receiving declaration materials, forwarding complete files with a preliminary opinion or returning incomplete files with a one-time list of missing items.
obligations.applies_from: 15 working days from receipt of declaration materials

evidence.quote: 省级网信部门应当自收到申报材料之日起15个工作日内完成完备性查验

obligations.summary: Network, telecommunications, public security and other personal information protection authorities must urge unlisted handlers that meet the criteria to declare designation.
obligations.conditional_on: Authorities find a handler meets the criteria but has not declared

evidence.quote: 应当督促其申报认定

obligations.summary: The national network department, with telecommunications and public security departments, determines and publishes the list of large personal information handlers.

evidence.quote: 国家网信部门会同国务院电信主管部门、公安部门等履行个人信息保护职责的部门依据认定条件，研究确定大型个人信息处理者清单，并向社会公告

obligations.summary: A designated handler that believes it has not met the criteria for 6 consecutive months may apply through the provincial network department to change its designation.
obligations.conditional_on: Handler has not met the criteria for 6 consecutive months

evidence.quote: 可以通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门提出变更认定申请

obligations.summary: Network, telecommunications, public security and other personal information protection authorities must share information on large handlers and coordinate their work.

evidence.quote: 网信部门、电信主管部门、公安机关等履行个人信息保护职责的部门应当加强大型个人信息处理者有关信息的共享和工作协同

obligations.summary: Large handlers must adopt encryption, de-identification, access control and anonymization measures to protect processed personal information; use of the national online identity authentication service, data labelling and personal information protection certification are permitted or encouraged.

evidence.quote: 应当采取加密、去标识化、访问控制、匿名化等措施保障所处理个人信息安全

obligations.summary: Large handlers are encouraged to innovate in personal information protection technologies, products and services, and to take part in international standard-setting and mutual recognition of rules.

evidence.quote: 鼓励大型个人信息处理者开展个人信息保护相关技术、产品、服务创新

obligations.summary: The national network department may list overseas organizations or individuals that infringe citizens' personal information rights or endanger national security or public interest on a restricted or prohibited provision list and take restriction or prohibition measures.
obligations.conditional_on: Overseas organization or individual engages in infringing or endangering personal information processing

evidence.quote: 国家网信部门可以将其列入限制或者禁止个人信息提供清单，予以公告

obligations.summary: Large handlers must process personal information following the principles of lawfulness, propriety, necessity and good faith, comply with laws and administrative regulations, and respect social morality and ethics.

evidence.quote: 应当遵循合法、正当、必要和诚信原则

obligations.summary: Large handlers must apply the principle of minimum necessity when collecting personal information, limited to what is necessary to provide products or services, and must not over-collect personal information.

evidence.quote: 收集个人信息，应当坚持最小必要原则

obligations.summary: Large handlers must publish personal information processing rules in clear language, itemising the listed matters (identity and contact of the handler and protection officer, per-function purposes and methods, embedded SDKs, recipients, retention, rights exercise channels and other legally required items); changes must be notified to individuals.

evidence.quote: 制定公开个人信息处理规则，应当通过清晰易懂的语言，真实、准确、完整、逐项列明下列事项

obligations.summary: Where processing relies on consent, large handlers must obtain separate consent for disclosure to other handlers, cross-border provision, public disclosure, processing of sensitive personal information, and other cases set by law or regulation, using the least intrusive method.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing based on individual consent in one of the listed situations

evidence.quote: 有下列情形之一的，应当取得个人的单独同意

obligations.summary: For personal information of minors under 14, large handlers must obtain consent from parents or other guardians and provide a convenient channel for guardians to consent and withdraw consent.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing personal information of minors under 14

evidence.quote: 应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意

obligations.summary: Where the purpose, method or categories of consent-based processing change, large handlers must obtain fresh consent.
obligations.conditional_on: Purpose, method or categories of consent-based processing change

evidence.quote: 应当重新取得个人同意

obligations.summary: For consent-based processing, large handlers must offer a convenient way to withdraw consent and a structured list of consented categories, purposes and methods.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing based on individual consent

evidence.quote: 应当提供便捷的撤回同意的方式

obligations.summary: Large handlers must store personal information collected and generated during operations within the People's Republic of China domestically.

evidence.quote: 应当将在中华人民共和国境内运营中收集和产生的个人信息存储在境内

obligations.summary: Large handlers must select data centres for domestic storage that are located in China, whose legal representative or actual controller is a Chinese national, and that meet national policy and standard requirements.

evidence.quote: 应当选择符合下列条件的数据中心，存储在中华人民共和国境内运营中收集和产生的个人信息

obligations.summary: Data centre management institutions must establish internal management systems and operating procedures and assist the handler in fulfilling protection duties, including an emergency plan for personal information security incidents.

evidence.quote: 应当建立健全内部管理制度和操作规程，协助大型个人信息处理者履行个人信息保护义务

obligations.summary: On a personal information security incident, data centre management institutions must immediately notify the handler, activate the emergency plan, and report to the designated authorities; they must also remediate security defects and follow authority requirements.
obligations.conditional_on: Personal information security incident occurs

evidence.quote: 应当立即通报大型个人信息处理者

obligations.summary: When entrusting personal information processing to a third-party data centre management institution, the handler must sign a written contract covering purpose, term, method, storage location, scale, categories, safeguards and rights and duties, and require compliance with Art. 14 and 15; the entrusted party must assist security management.
obligations.conditional_on: Entrusting personal information processing to a third-party data centre management institution

evidence.quote: 应当与其签订书面合同

obligations.summary: For personalised push or marketing by automated decision-making, large handlers must provide an easy-to-use option to turn off personalised recommendations, stop using data for them after opt-out, and offer deletion of user profile tags.
obligations.conditional_on: Personal information is pushed or used for marketing through automated decision-making

evidence.quote: 设置易于理解、便于访问和操作的个性化推荐关闭选项

obligations.summary: Where aggregation or fusion yields information that falls under PIPL Art. 28 sensitive personal information, the handler must identify and protect it as sensitive personal information.
obligations.conditional_on: Processed personal information meets PIPL Art. 28 sensitive criteria after aggregation or fusion

evidence.quote: 应当按照敏感个人信息进行识别与保护

obligations.summary: For qualifying portability requests, large handlers must transfer personal information in a common or machine-readable format within 30 working days after identity and request verification, notify the result, and explain if no transfer route exists; the period may be extended by up to 30 working days with reasons given.
obligations.applies_from: 30 working days after completing identity and request verification
obligations.conditional_on: Portability request meeting Regulations on Network Data Security Management Art. 25

evidence.quote: 应当自完成个人身份验证和请求验证后30个工作日内采取通用或者机器可读的格式转移个人信息

obligations.summary: Portability transfers must use identity verification and encrypted transmission, and handlers should support application programming interfaces or other standardized transfer routes.
obligations.conditional_on: Personal information portability

evidence.quote: 应当采取身份验证、加密传输等安全措施保障个人信息转移安全

obligations.summary: Where cross-border provision is needed, large handlers must apply for data export security assessment, conclude a personal information export standard contract, or obtain protection certification as national rules provide, and strengthen related technical and management measures.
obligations.conditional_on: Business needs require providing personal information outside China

evidence.quote: 应当按照国家有关规定申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同或者通过个人信息保护认证等

obligations.summary: Large handlers must assess the management and technical measures of overseas recipients and must suspend provision of personal information to a recipient that cannot fulfil its protection duties.
obligations.conditional_on: Cross-border provision of personal information

evidence.quote: 应当对境外接收方的管理和技术措施进行评估

obligations.summary: When providing personal information to another handler, large handlers must first apply de-identification or aggregated statistics where possible.
obligations.conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

evidence.quote: 应当优先采取去标识化、聚合统计等措施

obligations.summary: When providing personal information to another handler, large handlers must notify individuals of the recipient's name, contact, purpose, method and categories of information.
obligations.conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

evidence.quote: 向个人告知接收方的名称或者姓名、联系方式、处理目的、处理方式和个人信息的种类

obligations.summary: Large handlers must monitor and record outbound personal information transfers under the Cybersecurity Law Art. 23 and keep the related logs for at least six months.
obligations.conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

evidence.quote: 留存相关日志不少于六个月

obligations.summary: Where a recipient changes the original processing purpose or method, the recipient must obtain fresh individual consent; the recipient processes only within the notified scope.
obligations.conditional_on: Recipient changes original processing purpose or method

evidence.quote: 接收方变更原先的处理目的、处理方式的，应当重新取得个人同意

obligations.summary: Large handlers must not disclose personal information they process, except with separate individual consent; public disclosure must be limited to the minimum needed and use de-identification.
obligations.conditional_on: Public disclosure of processed personal information

evidence.quote: 不得公开其处理的个人信息，取得个人单独同意的除外

obligations.summary: Before publicly disclosing personal information, large handlers must conduct a personal information protection impact assessment.
obligations.conditional_on: Before public disclosure of personal information

evidence.quote: 公开个人信息前，应当开展个人信息保护影响评估

obligations.summary: Large handlers must provide a convenient way for individuals to refuse processing of personal information they have already made public; processing of such information with major rights impact also requires consent under law.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing of personal information already made public

evidence.quote: 应当为个人拒绝处理其已公开个人信息提供便捷途径

obligations.summary: Retention must be limited to the shortest period needed for products or services; large handlers must actively delete personal information when the purpose is achieved or no longer necessary, the service ends or retention expires, consent is withdrawn, or processing violates law or agreement; if retention is required by law or deletion is technically impossible, processing is limited to storage and security protection.
obligations.conditional_on: Purpose achieved, service ended, consent withdrawn, unlawful processing or other listed circumstances

evidence.quote: 处理个人信息的保存期限应当限于提供产品或者服务所必需的最短时限

obligations.summary: On an individual's deletion request, large handlers must delete promptly, or if deletion is not possible for good reason, reply within 15 working days.
obligations.conditional_on: Individual requests deletion of personal information

evidence.quote: 个人请求删除个人信息的，大型个人信息处理者应当及时删除

obligations.summary: Large handlers must establish internal management systems and operating procedures across processing, rights response and security duties, with monitoring, early warning and incident handling; the minimum content covers classification management, storage and access controls, impact assessment and compliance audit, minors' protection, complaints handling, and training.

evidence.quote: 应当围绕个人信息处理活动、个人行使权利响应、安全义务履行等环节，建立健全内部管理制度和操作规程

obligations.summary: Large handlers must designate a management-level member as personal information protection officer and publish the officer's contact details.

evidence.quote: 应当按照法律、行政法规的规定指定一名管理层成员担任个人信息保护负责人，并公开个人信息保护负责人的联系方式

obligations.summary: The protection officer must organise internal rules, participate in decisions with security risk, supervise processing, organise remedial measures and reports, prepare special rules for under-14 minors, and report regularly to the supervisory committee; the handler must support the officer in performing these duties.

evidence.quote: 个人信息保护负责人应当履行下列职责

obligations.summary: When a personal information leak, tampering or loss occurs, or a major violation risks large-scale rights harm, the protection officer must immediately organise remediation and report to the provincial network, telecommunications and public security authorities; suspected crimes are reported to public security and possible national security risks to state security organs.
obligations.conditional_on: Security incident or major violation that may cause large-scale rights harm occurs or may occur

evidence.quote: 应当立即组织采取补救措施，并向所在地省级网信部门和电信主管部门、公安机关等履行个人信息保护职责的部门报告

obligations.summary: Large handlers must designate personnel in business departments with personal information compliance audit capability to handle protection work, with staffing proportionate to business scale and protection duties, under the officer's guidance.

evidence.quote: 应当明确业务部门具备个人信息保护合规审计能力的人员负责个人信息保护工作

obligations.summary: Staff operating permissions must be granted on the principle of least authorization needed for business functions.

evidence.quote: 应当以实现业务功能所需的最小授权为原则，为工作人员配置个人信息处理的操作权限

obligations.summary: Operation records and permission approval records must be kept for at least six months; records of protection impact assessment reports and processing status must be kept for at least three years.

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理操作记录、权限审批记录等至少保存六个月

obligations.summary: Large handlers providing network platform services must set out rules, permissions and protection duties for in-platform product or service providers and urge them to establish internal protection systems.
obligations.conditional_on: Large handler provides network platform services

evidence.quote: 应当明确平台内产品或者服务提供者处理个人信息的规范、权限和保护个人信息的义务

obligations.summary: When an in-platform provider seriously violates law in processing personal information, the platform handler must immediately take measures such as suspending service and report to the provincial-level or higher network authority.
obligations.conditional_on: Handler discovers an in-platform provider seriously violating law in personal information processing

evidence.quote: 应当立即采取停止提供服务等处置措施，并向省级以上网信部门等履行个人信息保护职责的部门报告

obligations.summary: Large handlers must prepare each year and publish in the first half of the year a social responsibility report on personal information protection for the prior year, covering the listed matters.

evidence.quote: 应当每年编制并于上半年发布上一年度个人信息保护社会责任报告

obligations.summary: Before launching products or services or functions involving automated decision-making or sensitive personal information that may have major rights impact, large handlers must conduct a protection impact assessment and file the report with the national network department through the provincial department within 15 working days after completion.
obligations.applies_from: Before launch; filing within 15 working days after assessment completion
obligations.conditional_on: Launch of products, services or functions involving automated decision-making or sensitive personal information processing with major rights impact

evidence.quote: 应当事前开展个人信息保护影响评估，并在评估完成后的15个工作日内通过所在地省级网信部门将影响评估报告报国家网信部门备案

obligations.summary: Large handlers must strictly protect minors' personal information, identify minors through the national online identity authentication service, and designate dedicated, specially trained personnel for minors' protection.

evidence.quote: 应当严格保护未成年人个人信息，通过国家网络身份认证公共服务等方式识别未成年人

obligations.summary: Large handlers must carry out an annual compliance audit of minors' personal information protection under the Minors Network Protection Regulations.

evidence.quote: 每年开展未成年人个人信息保护合规审计

obligations.summary: Large handlers must conduct a personal information protection compliance audit at least once every two years; public display of audit and risk assessment results is encouraged and identified problems must be rectified.

evidence.quote: 应当每两年至少开展一次个人信息保护合规审计

obligations.summary: Large handlers must carry out a personal information processing risk assessment every year.

evidence.quote: 每年对其个人信息处理活动开展风险评估

obligations.summary: When entrusting audits or risk assessments to a third-party professional institution, the handler must cooperate and provide necessary access to network data facilities, systems and operation logs.
obligations.conditional_on: Entrusting audit or risk assessment to a third-party professional institution

evidence.quote: 应当配合第三方专业机构履行职责，为第三方专业机构开展工作提供必要保障

obligations.summary: A third-party professional institution performing audits or risk assessments for a large handler must be registered within China.
obligations.conditional_on: Engaged by a large handler for audits or risk assessments

evidence.quote: 应当注册在中华人民共和国境内

obligations.summary: A third-party institution that finds a large security risk in the handler's processing must promptly notify the handler and propose rectification.
obligations.conditional_on: Finds a larger security risk in the handler's processing

evidence.quote: 应当及时通报大型个人信息处理者并提出整改建议

obligations.summary: Large handlers must establish convenient complaint and reporting channels, state them in processing rules, and handle complaints within a committed period not exceeding 15 working days.

evidence.quote: 应当建立便捷的个人信息投诉、举报渠道

obligations.summary: Within 30 working days of designation, large handlers must report to the municipal network department the protection officer's details, measures ensuring the officer's duties, and data centre information including any entrusted contracts.

evidence.quote: 应当自被认定之日起30个工作日内向所在地设区的市级网信部门报送下列信息

obligations.summary: Changes in protection officer or data centre basic information must be reported within 30 working days of the change.
obligations.conditional_on: Basic information of protection officer or data centres changes

evidence.quote: 应当自变化之日起30个工作日内报送变更信息

obligations.summary: Within 6 months of designation, large handlers must set up a personal information protection supervisory committee mainly of external members, with an odd number of at least 7 members, at least two-thirds external, and an external head; they must also adopt work rules per the annex.

evidence.quote: 应当自被认定之日起6个月内成立主要由外部成员组成的个人信息保护监督委员会

obligations.summary: Large handlers must submit to the national network department, through the provincial department, the committee's establishment, work rules and member list.

evidence.quote: 通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门报送监督委员会成立情况、工作规则、成员名单等基本信息

obligations.summary: External committee members must meet listed conditions, including independence, serving no more than 3 handlers, at least 3 years of protection experience, good reputation, and no adverse records.

evidence.quote: 外部成员应当符合下列条件

obligations.summary: Large handlers engaging external members must conduct a security background check, and may request public security assistance.
obligations.conditional_on: Engaging external members

evidence.quote: 应当对外部成员进行安全背景审查

obligations.summary: External members must maintain independence in their identity and duties; persons related to the handler, major shareholders or senior shareholders in the past year are excluded.

evidence.quote: 外部成员应当保持身份和履行职责的独立性

obligations.summary: External members must self-check independence annually and report to the board or its authorised body, which must assess each serving member annually, issue a special opinion and disclose it in the social responsibility report.

evidence.quote: 应当每年对在任外部成员独立性情况进行评估并出具专项意见

obligations.summary: Large handlers must set out external members' allowances in the committee's work rules; allowance standards are approved by the board or its authorised body.

evidence.quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当通过监督委员会工作规则明确外部成员津贴

obligations.summary: The supervisory committee must focus its oversight on the handler's compliance system, processing rules, sensitive and minors' data, impact and compliance assessments, incidents, cross-border compliance, automated decision-making, rights requests and complaints, officer performance and the social responsibility report.

evidence.quote: 监督委员会重点对大型个人信息处理者下列事项进行监督

obligations.summary: The national network department and other personal information protection authorities may supervise the establishment and operation of the supervisory committee.

evidence.quote: 依法对大型个人信息处理者设立、运行监督委员会的活动进行监督管理

obligations.summary: Large handlers must cooperate with authorities' supervision of the committee, including providing explanations and materials on its establishment and operation.
obligations.conditional_on: Authority requests explanations or materials on committee establishment or operation

evidence.quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当予以配合

obligations.summary: Each year in the first quarter, large handlers must report the committee's prior-year performance through the provincial department; at least every two years they must also report a personal information protection compliance audit report.

evidence.quote: 应当于每年第一季度通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门报送监督委员会上一年度履职情况

obligations.summary: The national network department must share relevant information on committee reports and audits with the telecommunications and public security departments.

evidence.quote: 国家网信部门将相关情况通报国务院电信主管部门、公安部门

obligations.summary: Authorities receiving complaints or reports against handlers, committees or members must handle them promptly under law and inform the complainant of the outcome.
obligations.conditional_on: Receipt of a complaint or report

evidence.quote: 收到投诉、举报的部门应当依法及时处理，并将处理结果告知投诉、举报人

obligations.summary: Staff of authorities, committees, third-party professional institutions and data centre management institutions must keep confidential the personal, personal information, trade secret and business information they learn in their work.

evidence.quote: 应当对工作中知悉的个人隐私、个人信息、商业秘密、保密商务信息等依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供

obligations.summary: Large handlers must implement data classification and grading protection, multi-level cybersecurity protection, and commercial cryptography protection requirements.

evidence.quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当落实数据分类分级保护、网络安全等级保护、商用密码保护有关要求

obligations.summary: Large handlers that are critical information infrastructure operators must also comply with national rules on critical information infrastructure security.
obligations.conditional_on: Large handler is a critical information infrastructure operator

evidence.quote: 还应当遵守国家关于关键信息基础设施安全的有关规定

obligations.summary: Annex: work rules of the supervisory committee must at least meet the listed requirements, covering independence, composition, term limits, meetings, voting, reporting and the handler's support duties.
obligations.conditional_on: Handler establishes a personal information protection supervisory committee

evidence.quote: 工作规则至少应当符合以下要求

obligations.summary: Annex item 11: the committee must hold a regular meeting at least every 6 months and may hold an extraordinary meeting on proposal of one third or more of its members when evidence of unlawful processing exists.

evidence.quote: 监督委员会至少每6个月召开一次定期会议

obligations.summary: Annex item 16: in performing its duties the committee must not interfere with the handler's normal operation or obtain information beyond its duties, and must keep learned information confidential.

evidence.quote: 不得干预大型个人信息处理者正常运营

obligations.summary: Annex item 17: the handler's bodies and personnel must cooperate with the committee's lawful supervision and must not obstruct it, refuse it in bad faith, conceal information or interfere with its independence.
obligations.conditional_on: Committee performs lawful supervision

evidence.quote: 大型个人信息处理者有关机构、人员应当对监督委员会依法开展的监督予以配合

obligations.summary: Annex item 17: each committee member must submit a report on the prior year's performance to the handler's board or its authorised body in the first quarter of each year.

evidence.quote: 监督委员会成员应当于每年第一季度向大型个人信息处理者董事会等决策机构或者其授权机构提交上一年度履职情况报告

enforcement.authority: 网信部门、电信主管部门、公安机关等履行个人信息保护职责的部门
enforcement.triggered_by: Supervisory committee reports, compliance audit reports or impact assessment reports that violate law, administrative regulations, departmental rules or this Provisions
